_comment: Hand-maintained input to `pnpm identities`, which treats one normalised
name as one sailor by default.
unify    - one sailor published under several spellings. `name` is the
display name; `aliases` are the other spellings as published.
separate - a name that really is two different sailors.
assign   - one published cell, by [series, sail, slot], that names a
sailor too thinly to recognise (a bare first name), given the
person it is. Row-specific, never a global alias.
Merge only on evidence. Over-linking puts another sailor's results in
someone's record, which is worse than leaving two records apart.

unify.name: Gary Haughton
unify.note: Published as "Gary Haguhton" at the 2026 Nationals; the same boat (1017, Crazy 8, RIYC) is Gary Haughton's at the 2026 Easterns.

assign.name: John Sheehy
assign.note: Published as helm "John", crew "Sheehy" at the 2026 Nationals; the same boat (1016, Flying Tiger, RSGYC) is John Sheehy's at the 2026 Easterns. The crew is not identified.
